svg.title: Choose work separately from executing its computation
svg.desc: One lifecycle authority • one executor • at most one batch in flight in this teaching baseline
svg.text: Choose work separately from executing its computation
One lifecycle authority • one executor • at most one batch in flight in this teaching baseline
1. Scheduler chooses eligible work
Bounded waiting queue → admission credits
Select request / phase / position / budget
Policy changes choices, not model semantics
2. Immutable descriptor crosses boundary
Batch / request / attempt / step identity
Row map, KV generations and readiness
Retain inputs, workspace and output owners
3. Executor validates and computes
Supported shapes / formats / memory
Private candidate KV and ready logits
Enqueue return does not prove completion
4. Authority reconciles completion
Validate identity; commit progress once
Stop or make next decode eligible
Retire storage only after every final user
New arrivals may wait while execution runs; they cannot mutate the in-flight batch.
At a safe iteration boundary, the next batch may contain a different set of requests.
